messages.subject: Re: Deploying Shiny Apps
parts:
Warning: no DISPLAY variable so Tk is not available
Error in structure(.External(.C_dotTcl, ...), class = "tclObj") : 
  [tcl] can't find package BWidget.

Error : unable to load R code in package ‘rpanel’
ERROR: lazy loading failed for package ‘rpanel’
* removing ‘/usr/local/lib/R/site-library/rpanel’


rpanel needs the BWidget system package.

http://docs.rstudio.com/shinyapps.io/getting-started.html#system-packages

Furthermore, if it needs Tcl/Tk you may be out of luck: http://docs.rstudio.com/shinyapps.io/applications.html#debugging-your-application
